crossRefs.note: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers…
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers, to receive his fruit.
The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head…
The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
“But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience…
He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to…
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the…
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…
“But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you…
how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was…
How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has…
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…

translations.web: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
translations.bsb: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
translations.kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
translations.asv: Ye serpents, ye offspring of vipers, how shall ye escape the judgment of hell?
